title: Dev-C cleaning database bug
symptom: After cleaning the database to 3 months in AAPS and unpausing NS upload, AAPS sends over 55000 data points, but the Nightscout web page reports only 1 day of data instead of 3 months.
evidence_quote: Once all the data is uploaded, I go to my NS web page and try reports. I only have 1 days data. Theoretically, there should be 3 months data.
